_comment: Pipelines the dashboard can send a Newsworthy item to. queueFile is a JSON file with shape {pending:[...]} that the target pipeline's own launcher/prompt is expected to check. Add more pipelines here as they're built - the dashboard reads this list to populate the 'send to pipeline' dropdown.
